# v2.0 Roadmap Structure Awareness

**Date:** 2026-01-17  
**Version:** 1.0  
**Status:** ACTIVE

---

## Overview

All prompts in `.github/prompts/` are now aware of the **NEW LEAN ROADMAP STRUCTURE (v2.0)** deployed on 2026-01-17.

This document serves as a central reference for prompt developers and agents about the new roadmap organization.

---

## Key File Locations (v2.0)

### 📋 Master Plan (Single Source of Truth)
- **File:** `.github/roadmap/cortex-master.yaml`
- **Version:** v2.0 (Continuation format)
- **Size:** 212KB (organized, clean)
- **Contents:**
  - `metadata`: version, transition info, completion summary (258 ACs from v1)
  - `phase_tracker`: All 13 active phases with status
  - `governance`: Tier-0 rules, phase enforcement, audit location
  - `estimation_summary`: Hours and buffer calculations

### 📂 Active Phases (13 total)
- **Directory:** `.github/roadmap/phases/`
- **Files:** `phase-07-intent-router.yaml` through `phase-20-*.yaml`
- **Structure:**
  - `phase-07-intent-router.yaml`: 14 ACs, fully defined, ready for implementation
  - `phase-08.yaml` through `phase-10.yaml`: Fully defined
  - `phase-11.yaml` through `phase-20.yaml`: Stub templates, ready for definition

### 🗂️ v1 Baseline Reference (Archive)
- **Directory:** `.github/roadmap/_archives/`
- **Key Files:**
  - `cortex-master-v1.yaml`: Original v1 plan (200KB+, reference only)
  - `phases-v1/`: All original phases (phase-01 through old layout)
  - `docs/`: Historical documentation (18+ files)
  - `issues/`: Issue tracking materials
  - `recommendations/`: Automation configs
  - `ARCHIVE-INDEX.md`: Navigation guide for archives

### 📊 Reports & Documentation
- **Directory:** `.github/roadmap/reports/`
- **Contents:** Phase completion reports (generated as phases complete)
- **Format:** `phase-XX-completion-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md`

### 📖 v2.0 Documentation
- **Files:**
  - `.github/roadmap/README.md`: v2.0 usage guide (9.7KB)
  - `.github/roadmap/TRANSITION-SUMMARY.md`: What was accomplished
  - `.github/roadmap/COMPLETION-CHECKLIST.md`: 40+ verification items
  - `.github/roadmap/_archives/ARCHIVE-INDEX.md`: Archive navigation

## Migration Pattern for Other Prompts

If you're creating new prompts, use this pattern for v2.0 awareness:

```markdown
## ⚠️ ROADMAP v2.0 AWARENESS (2026-01-17)

**This [system/tool/agent] is aware of the NEW LEAN ROADMAP STRUCTURE (v2.0):**

✅ **Key Files:**
- **SSOT:** `.github/roadmap/cortex-master.yaml` (v2.0 - Continuation)
- **Phases:** `.github/roadmap/phases/phase-XX.yaml` (13 phases)
- **v1 Ref:** `.github/roadmap/_archives/cortex-master-v1.yaml` (258+ ACs baseline)
- **Governance:** `cortex-brain/tier0/governance/` (all v1 rules continue)
- **Audit:** `cortex-brain/state/governance.db` (unbroken from v1)

✅ **What This Means:**
- When checking [feature] → Query `.github/roadmap/[location]` (not old v1 structure)
- When validating [pattern] → Reference `_archives/` (v1 patterns still apply)
- When enforcing [rule] → All governance from v1 still active
```

## Quick Reference: File Location Changes

| What You Need | v1 Location | v2.0 Location | Notes |
|---------------|------------|---------------|-------|
| Current phase status | cortex-master.yaml (root) | `.github/roadmap/cortex-master.yaml` | phase_tracker section |
| Phase specifications | Various locations | `.github/roadmap/phases/phase-XX.yaml` | Clean organization |
| v1 reference patterns | cortex-master.yaml | `.github/roadmap/_archives/cortex-master-v1.yaml` | Archive only |
| Governance rules | Various | `cortex-brain/tier0/governance/core-rules.yaml` | Unchanged from v1 |
| Audit trail | Same database | `cortex-brain/state/governance.db` | Continuous, unbroken |
| Reports | Various | `.github/roadmap/reports/` | Centralized |
| Documentation | Root scattered | `.github/roadmap/_archives/docs/` | Organized in archive |

## v2.0 Structure Benefits for Prompts

✨ **Cleaner Organization**
- Phases no longer scattered in root
- Documentation consolidated
- Clear separation: active (v2.0) vs reference (archives)

✨ **Easier Navigation**
- `phase_tracker` in cortex-master.yaml for quick status
- Consistent naming: `phase-XX.yaml`
- Clear archive structure for v1 reference

✨ **Better Continuation Awareness**
- v2.0 explicitly documents v1 baseline
- All 258 ACs referenced as completion point
- Makes v3.0 transition pattern clear

✨ **Governance Clarity**
- All rules remain active (no surprises)
- Audit trail unbroken
- Phase enforcement map clear and accessible

## Verification Checklist

When integrating v2.0 awareness into a new prompt, verify:

- [ ] References use new file paths (`.github/roadmap/` not root)
- [ ] Phase queries check `phase_tracker` (not old structure)
- [ ] v1 baseline reference points to `_archives/cortex-master-v1.yaml`
- [ ] Governance rules assumed to be same as v1 (all 25 SKULL rules)
- [ ] Audit trail assumed continuous from v1
- [ ] Documentation references point to `_archives/docs/` where applicable
